payments_manual_proof.name: payments_manual_proof
payments_manual_proof.value:
"payments"."method" <> 'bank_transfer' or "payments"."status" <> 'successful' or (
        "payments"."confirmed_by_admin_id" is not null
        and coalesce(trim("payments"."bank_reference"), '') <> ''
        and coalesce(trim("payments"."note"), '') <> ''
      )
